**Previous:** [Fireworks Training: Step One](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/firework-isles?locationIds=427597)

_Successfully created and launched the first firework! Upon returning to the Fireworks Workshop, Nikki discovered that Scintillada was missing. Miss Vita delivered his message-- head to Songbreeeze Highland to find the Fireworks Diviner. Marques Jr. has already departed--catch up with him there!_

- Glitter Bubbles: Fresh x50
- Blings x12K

**Rewards:**
- Diamonds x50
- Shiny Bubbles x100
- Bling x12K
